def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    df["body_mass_g"] = (
        df["body_mass_g"].astype(str)
        .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(df["body_mass_g"], errors="coerce")
    # Fix out-of-range values (e.g. 3700000 -> 3700)
    mask = df["body_mass_g"] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, "body_mass_g"] = df.loc[mask, "body_mass_g"] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    return df.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].sum().to_dict()
